patch.why: The timeout was too short for the pipette to settle in microgravity, as it was still moving at 32.9 mm/s when the 2-second wait ended.
patch.expect: With a 5-second timeout, the pipette will have sufficient time to come to rest (speed < threshold) before the check fails, allowing the step to succeed in orbit.
patch.note:
earth (1 g): PASS in 6.2 s. At the end: pipette1's centre at (-0.2, 1.1, 20.4) mm from cartridge1's centre, its bottom 0.4 mm above cartridge1's pocket floor (4.6 mm below its rim), moving at 0.2 mm/s, not held, seated in cartridge1.
orbit (0 g): FAIL after 8.2 s at s2 op 4 (wait_until object_still pipette1 (up to 2 s)).
  Measured: timed out after 2 s: pipette1 moving at 32.9 mm/s.
  Let go at 5.9 s with pipette1's centre at (0.2, -0.8, 19.9) mm from cartridge1's centre, its bottom 0.1 mm below cartridge1's pocket floor (5.1 mm below its rim).
  At the end: pipette1's centre at (-43.9, 4.5, 69.8) mm from cartridge1's centre, its bottom 49.8 mm above cartridge1's pocket floor (44.8 mm above its rim), moving at 32.9 mm/s, not held, not seated: pipette1 is 44.1 mm from cartridge1's centre, not inside it.

patch.why: The pipette drifted at 7.7 mm/s in orbit because it lacked lateral contact; offsetting it 5 mm in x will make it touch the cartridge pocket wall, creating a normal force to damp motion.

earth (1 g): PASS in 6.2 s. At the end: pipette1's centre at (-0.2, 1.1, 20.4) mm from cartridge1's centre, its bottom 0.4 mm above cartridge1's pocket floor (4.6 mm below its rim), moving at 0.2 mm/s, not held, seated in cartridge1.

  Measured: timed out after 10 s: pipette1 moving at 7.7 mm/s.
  Let go at 5.9 s with pipette1's centre at (0.2, -0.8, 19.9) mm from cartridge1's centre, its bottom 0.1 mm below cartridge1's pocket floor (5.1 mm below its rim).
  At the end: pipette1's centre at (-95.2, 30.1, 8.2) mm from cartridge1's centre, its bottom 11.8 mm below cartridge1's pocket floor (16.8 mm below its rim), moving at 7.7 mm/s, not held, not seated: pipette1 is 99.8 mm from cartridge1's centre, not inside it.
